energy_module_description: Your customers' buildings live: power and consumption per zone, doors that let energy out, thresholds and alerts that become orders.
energy_ingest_code: A zone's or door's code: text of 1 to 40 characters
energy_ingest_moment: An ISO 8601 moment with its offset, e.g. 2026-10-17T08:00:00Z
energy_ingest_quarter: An interval starts on a quarter hour (:00, :15, :30, :45)
energy_ingest_peak_below_average: The peak is below the average
energy_ingest_energy_mismatch: kWh doesn't match the average power over 15 minutes (avgKw / 4)
energy_ingest_state: A door's state is open or closed
energy_ingest_site: The site's id, a whole number
energy_ingest_empty: A batch has at least one reading or door event
energy_ingest_too_large: The batch is larger than 1 MB
energy_ingest_invalid: The batch isn't in the energy feed's format
energy_ingest_unknown_codes: The site has no such zones or doors
energy_description: Your customers' buildings live: power and consumption per zone, the doors that let energy out, and the alerts.
energy_settings_description: The tokens the sites' gateways post their readings with, to {url}.
energy_settings_sites_description: What a gateway names in its batches: the site's id and its zones' and doors' codes, which each site's setup page sets up.
energy_tokens_managers: Only owners and admins make and revoke tokens.
energy_tokens_empty: No tokens yet: make one for a site's gateway.
energy_token_name_required: Name the token, e.g. P1 gateway Ede
energy_token_created_description: It isn't shown again. The gateway sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
energy_advice_peak: Shift peak use to 12:00–15:00: about {kw} lower peak.
energy_advice_no_comparison: No previous period to compare with yet.
energy_advice_night: A night mode for climate and lighting: about {kwh} savings.
energy_advice_sectional: Close {name} or activate the dock shelter — {kw} kW heat loss.
energy_advice_cold: Check {name}: the door has been open {minutes} min, {kw} kW extra cooling.
energy_advice_zone: Reduce the load in {zone} or shift peak use to off-peak hours.
energy_alerts_description: Zones over or near their thresholds, and doors open too long: make an order of one, or resolve it.
energy_alert_not_open: The alert isn't open any more
energy_thresholds_description: Energy alerts per zone: a zone over its max power or consumption per day raises an alert, at 85% one that it's near.
energy_thresholds_managers: Only owners and admins change the thresholds.
energy_consumers_description: What uses the power in the zone, with its share of today's consumption estimated by rated power.
energy_portal_description: Your sites' power and consumption, against the previous period, and what the doors let out.
energy_portal_none: No energy is measured at your sites yet.
energy_card_description: The sites whose power and consumption are measured per zone.
energy_setup_add_site_description: One of your customers' sites: its zones, consumers and doors follow on its setup page.
energy_setup_site_taken: This site's energy is monitored already
energy_setup_site_description: The main connection's contract, the solar panels, and what a kWh costs and emits. Days are counted in the site's time zone.
energy_setup_site_delete_description: Its zones, consumers, doors and thresholds go with it. A site with readings or alerts can't be deleted.
energy_setup_site_measured: The site has readings, door events or alerts, which would be lost: it can't be deleted.
energy_site_delete_refused: This site's energy is monitored as {name}. Delete that energy site first.
energy_site_delete_refused_off: This site still has energy data. Switch Energy on and delete its energy site first.
energy_setup_name_hint: Leave it empty for the customer's and the site's names.
energy_setup_peak_invalid: A number of kW above 0, up to 100,000
energy_setup_kwh_year_invalid: A whole number of kWh, 0 or more
energy_setup_pv_invalid: A number of kW, 0 or more, up to 100,000
energy_setup_tariff_invalid: A price per kWh above 0, up to €10
energy_setup_co2_invalid: A number of kg per kWh, 0 to 10
energy_setup_time_zone_hint: Where the site is, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam.
energy_setup_time_zone_invalid: A time zone such as Europe/Amsterdam
energy_setup_code_required: Fill in the code the gateway sends, up to 40 characters
energy_setup_zones_description: The parts of the site with a meter of their own; the gateway names them by their codes. A new zone gets default thresholds after its first day of readings, or set them now:
energy_setup_zones_none: No zones yet: add the first one.
energy_setup_zone_description: A part of the site with a meter of its own.
energy_setup_zone_elsewhere: Choose one of this site's zones
energy_setup_zone_code_taken: Another zone of this site has this code
energy_setup_zone_delete_description: Its consumers, doors and thresholds go with it. A zone with readings or alerts can't be deleted.
energy_setup_zone_measured: The zone has readings or alerts (or its doors events), which would be lost: it can't be deleted. Rename it, or switch its alerts off.
energy_setup_area_invalid: A whole number of m², 0 or more
energy_setup_consumers_description: What uses the power in each zone, maybe one of the site's units.
energy_setup_consumer_description: Something in a zone that uses power, with its rated power.
energy_setup_rated_invalid: A number of kW above 0, up to 100,000
energy_setup_unit_hint: One of the units at the customer's site.
energy_setup_unit_elsewhere: Choose one of this site's units
energy_setup_doors_description: The doors whose open time costs energy; the gateway's door events name them by their codes.
energy_setup_door_description: A door in a zone: the power lost while it's open, and how long it may be open before it raises an alert.
energy_setup_door_code_taken: Another door of this site has this code
energy_setup_door_delete_description: A door with events or alerts can't be deleted.
energy_setup_door_measured: The door has events or alerts, which would be lost: it can't be deleted. Rename it instead.
energy_setup_door_unit_hint: One of the units at the customer's site; a dock's door shows the dock's state on its card.
energy_setup_loss_invalid: A number of kW, 0 or more, up to 100,000
energy_setup_minutes_invalid: A whole number of minutes, 1 to 1,440
energy_hero_description: Compare periods, follow the P1 data live and zoom in to zone and installation level.
energy_building_hint: Click a floor or zone for details
energy_meter_pv_estimate: Estimated from {kwp} kWp and the time of day
energy_doors_heading: Door watch — sectional doors, cold and freezer stores
energy_doors_description: Live state, time open and energy loss per door
energy_chart_month_until: This month (up to day {day}) versus last month
energy_panel_installations_estimate: Now, by each one's share of its zone's rated power
energy_signals_none: All active zones stay within their thresholds.
